title: Share-Based Compensation - ASC 718
learning_objectives: Account for stock options using grant date fair value
Calculate compensation expense over vesting period

overview.principle: Stock-based compensation measured at GRANT DATE FAIR VALUE and recognized as expense over vesting/service period
overview.scope: Employee stock options, restricted stock, RSUs, SARs, ESPP
overview.measurement_date: Grant date (when employer and employee reach mutual understanding of terms)
overview.no_remeasurement: Generally no remeasurement after grant date (with exceptions for certain awards)

stock_options.grant_date_fair_value: Estimated using option pricing model (Black-Scholes, binomial)
stock_options.recognition: Expense grant date fair value ratably over vesting period

journal_entries.at_grant: Memorandum entry (no journal entry until expense recognized)
journal_entries.during_vesting:
DR Compensation Expense $XXX
   CR Additional Paid-in Capital - Stock Options $XXX
journal_entries.at_exercise:
DR Cash (exercise price)
DR APIC - Stock Options (amount accumulated)
   CR Common Stock (par)
   CR APIC (excess)
journal_entries.if_forfeited:
Reverse previously recognized compensation expense:
DR APIC - Stock Options $XXX
   CR Compensation Expense $XXX

example.facts: Grant 1,000 options with FV $10 each on 1/1/Y1. Vest ratably over 3 years.

cliff_vesting.description: All options vest at once after service period
cliff_vesting.example: 1,000 options vest after 3 years (all or nothing)

accounting_choice: Straight-line: Treat as single award, expense evenly over total vesting period
Accelerated (graded): Treat each tranche separately, front-load expense

performance_vesting.accounting: Estimate probability of achievement, adjust if estimates change

restricted_stock_units_rsus.definition: Promise to deliver shares in future (upon vesting)
restricted_stock_units_rsus.grant_date_valuation: Fair value of stock at grant date (number of units × stock price)
restricted_stock_units_rsus.accounting: Same as options - expense FV over vesting period
restricted_stock_units_rsus.at_vesting:
Issue shares:
DR APIC - RSUs
   CR Common Stock (par)
   CR APIC (excess)
restricted_stock_units_rsus.vs_restricted_stock: RSUs: No shares issued until vesting. Restricted stock: Shares issued at grant but subject to forfeiture if unvested.

restricted_stock.definition: Actual shares issued at grant, but subject to forfeiture if employee leaves before vesting
restricted_stock.accounting: Measure at FV on grant date, recognize expense over vesting period
restricted_stock.at_grant:
DR Unearned Compensation (contra-equity)
   CR Common Stock (par)
   CR APIC (excess)
restricted_stock.during_vesting:
DR Compensation Expense
   CR Unearned Compensation
restricted_stock.dividends_during_vesting: If paid to employees holding unvested shares, treat as additional compensation expense

employee_stock_purchase_plan_espp.description: Employees purchase stock at discount (typically 85% of market)

non_compensatory_criteria: No option features (beyond short reasonable period to enroll)
Discount ≤ 5% OR discount ≤ per-share cost of public offering
compensatory_or_not.if_compensatory: Measure discount at grant date, recognize as expense

stock_appreciation_rights_sars.description: Right to receive cash (or stock) equal to appreciation in stock price
stock_appreciation_rights_sars.cash_settled: Liability award - remeasure to FV each period through vesting and settlement
stock_appreciation_rights_sars.stock_settled: Equity award - measure at grant date, no remeasurement
stock_appreciation_rights_sars.accounting_difference: Cash SARs create liability, revalued each period. Stock SARs treated like stock options.

accounting_policy_election: Estimate forfeitures and adjust compensation expense (reduce for expected forfeitures)
Account for forfeitures when they occur (no estimate)
forfeitures.if_estimated: Reduce compensation expense for estimated forfeitures. True-up if actual differs from estimate.
forfeitures.if_when_occur: Recognize full expense assuming all will vest. Reverse expense when forfeiture actually occurs.

modifications.accounting: Recognize INCREMENTAL fair value (excess of FV after modification over FV before modification)
modifications.example: Options originally FV $10. Modified (e.g., reduce exercise price). New FV $15. Incremental $5 recognized as additional expense over remaining vesting period.
modifications.minimum: Must recognize at least original grant date FV (can't reduce below original even if modification decreases FV)

tax_effects.non_qualified_stock_options_nqso: Company gets tax deduction when employee exercises (deduction = employee's ordinary income)
tax_effects.deferred_tax_asset: Recognize DTA for future deductible amount as compensation expense recognized (for NQSOs)
tax_effects.excess_tax_benefit: If tax deduction exceeds book expense, recognize excess tax benefit in income (ASU 2016-09 changed from APIC)

cpa_exam_strategies.measurement: Grant date fair value. Do NOT remeasure (except liability awards).
cpa_exam_strategies.expense_recognition: Total FV / Vesting period. Recognize expense evenly unless accelerated method elected for graded vesting.
cpa_exam_strategies.options_vs_rsus: Options: Use pricing model. RSUs: Stock price × units. Both expensed over vesting period.
cpa_exam_strategies.forfeitures: Either estimate or account when occur (policy election).
cpa_exam_strategies.modifications: Incremental FV = Additional expense. Minimum = original grant FV.
cpa_exam_strategies.common_tested: Basic expense calculation over vesting period, journal entries at grant/vesting/exercise.

key_points: Measure stock-based compensation at GRANT DATE FAIR VALUE
Recognize expense over vesting/service period (straight-line typically)
Stock options: Use option pricing model (Black-Scholes, binomial)
RSUs: Fair value = Stock price × Units at grant date
Restricted stock: Shares issued at grant, subject to forfeiture
Forfeitures: Estimate or account when occur (policy election)
Modifications: Recognize incremental fair value, minimum original grant FV
No remeasurement after grant (except liability-classified awards like cash SARs)
